package violations

import (
	"io/fs"
	xos "os"
)

// ReadAliased hides os.ReadFile behind an import alias.
func ReadAliased() ([]byte, error) {
	return xos.ReadFile("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// Dir reads the file system without safeio's checks.
func Dir() fs.FS {
	return xos.DirFS("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// PrintStdout writes to stdout without fmt.Print.
func PrintStdout() {
	_, _ = xos.Stdout.WriteString("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}
